name: Film strip
oneLiner: a real scanned film strip with the brand's screens in its frames runs fast past a lamp-lit gate (sprocket holes glowing, motion blur, edge numbers), slows on a long tail until the chosen frame clacks into register and the lamp flares, then that frame lifts off the film toward the lens as a lit print with a caption while the strip falls back
say: when the speaker looks back through past work and lands on one piece ('out of everything I made, this is the one', 'go back to frame one'): cut in on the look-back, the clack lands on 'this one', the print lifts as they name it. Set pick to the screen that matters and label to its name
